name: [UPDATE 3] Coin Flip
desc:
🪙 Coin Flip Simulator — flip, upgrade, rebirth, repeat!

💸 Use codes "SORRYFORDELAY", "BLACKHOLE" and "CHESTS!" for FREE coins, chests & boosts!

The incremental coin flipping game! Flip your coin, hit streaks and crits, and climb 20 rebirth tiers from Bronze to Celestial and even further beyond!

[⭐ Features]
- Flip to earn — heads streaks & massive CRITS
- 20 Rebirth tiers, each with a new coin skin
- Chests, potions & 80+ collectible items
- Refine items for permanent boosts
- Unlock AUTO-FLIP + AFK/offline earnings
- Daily & weekly quests + login rewards
- Global leaderboards — become the ultimate flipper
- Full mobile support

⚡ Weekly updates — 👍 Like, ⭐ Favorite & join the group for a FREE gift!
